who: Mark, 41, three kids, a project manager
talk:
Hi, I'm Mark, I'm forty-one, I live in Haarlem with my wife Anna and our three kids. Tim is twelve, Lisa is nine and little Ben is four. I work as a project manager at a construction company, nine to five more or less, but the evenings are chaos. Right now the big thing is Tim going to secondary school: there are open days this month and we have to choose a school by March. Our car is due for its service, and the car insurance renews in January. Anna's birthday is on the twentieth and I have no idea what to get her. And I have to fix the leaking tap in the bathroom, it's been dripping for weeks.

Money wise, we're saving for a bigger house, maybe in two years. I'd like to spend more time with each of the kids on their own, not just all together. And honestly I'm tired all the time, I sit all day and barely move, I should walk more.

I think that's the main stuff. It's a busy house.
now: Booking the open days for Tim’s schools.
habit: A walk after dinner, every evening.
